description: This Java class 'DefaultPolicyConfig' is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and defines the default implementation for policy configuration. It constructs configuration objects related to supervision, activity checks, and snapshots, loaded from a specified configuration source.

classes.name: DefaultPolicyConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing PolicyConfig, representing the default configuration for policies, constructed from a scoped configuration object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create DefaultPolicyConfig instance from a Config object.

methods.name: getSupervisorConfig
methods.description: Returns the SupervisorConfig component of the policy configuration.

methods.name: getActivityCheckConfig
methods.description: Returns the ActivityCheckConfig component of the policy configuration.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotConfig component of the policy configuration.
